name: elohim
description: A reproducible numerical-instrument skill: measures exotic mathematics, pins every claim to a checksum, and fails loudly when a measurement drifts.

interface.shortDescription: Reproducible exotic-mathematics instrument with a checksum-pinned claim ledger.
interface.longDescription: Runs a stdlib-only Python instrument that measures Parry numbers, Pisot decay signatures, superellipse perimeters, log-star behaviour, a p-adic ladder and a Collatz trace. Every published claim is pinned in a JSON ledger with a tolerance and a residual, the instrument itself is sha256-pinned so the goalposts cannot be moved silently, and a hygiene lint refuses any source file containing a name that command-line log sanitisers rewrite.
defaultPrompt: Run the ELOHIM gate and tell me what changed.
Verify these mathematical claims with ELOHIM before I ship them.
Use ELOHIM to turn this numerical assumption into a pinned, testable fact.
